(5) /book/BK-260726-654C2 confirmation page 'Copy Link' button clicked, toast 'Link copied' shown, no exception. clipboard.js util reviewed: correctly implements 3-tier fallback (navigator.clipboard.writeText under isSecureContext → hidden textarea + document.execCommand('copy') → window.prompt), returns boolean. critical_code_review_comments: clipboard.js correctly guards navigator.clipboard with window.isSecureContext to avoid PWA/insecure-context throws — good.
copyToClipboard swallows both failures silently before showing window.prompt; consider logging to console for debuggability, but functionally correct.
Prior iteration comments still apply: server.py > 1000 lines could be modularised.
seed_data_creation: None new. Used existing TEST_ prebookings from previous iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clipboard util at /app/frontend/src/lib/clipboard.js is the canonical copy helper. In Playwright, use `page.context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write'], origin=BASE)` (attribute, not method) to enable clipboard verification. To verify clipboard content: `await page.evaluate('navigator.clipboard.readText()')`.
rca of the issue: Original bug: raw navigator.clipboard.writeText() rejects/throws in PWA or insecure contexts, and the unhandled promise surfaced as an error toast. Fix: introduced copyToClipboard() in /app/frontend/src/lib/clipboard.js with 3-tier fallback (secure-context navigator.clipboard → execCommand textarea → window.prompt) that never throws and returns a boolean. All 5 call sites refactored. Verified via Playwright: click on copy-public-link now succeeds with 'Public link copied' toast and correct clipboard content.
